verses.ar: «فَٱلْآنَ يَا إِسْرَائِيلُ ٱسْمَعِ ٱلْفَرَائِضَ وَٱلْأَحْكَامَ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أُعَلِّمُكُمْ لِتَعْمَلُوهَا، لِكَيْ تَحْيَوْا وَتَدْخُلُوا وَتَمْتَلِكُوا ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلَّتِي ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُ آبَائِكُمْ يُعْطِيكُمْ.
verses.kjv: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do [them], that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
verses.web: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, gives you.

verses.ar: لَا تَزِيدُوا عَلَى ٱلْكَلَامِ ٱلَّذِي أَنَا أُوصِيكُمْ بِهِ وَلَا تُنَقِّصُوا مِنْهُ، لِكَيْ تَحْفَظُوا وَصَايَا ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكُمُ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أُوصِيكُمْ بِهَا.
verses.kjv: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish [ought] from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
verses.web: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you.

verses.ar: أَعْيُنُكُمْ قَدْ أَبْصَرَتْ مَا فَعَلَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ بِبَعْلَ فَغُورَ. إِنَّ كُلَّ مَنْ ذَهَبَ وَرَاءَ بَعْلَ فَغُورَ أَبَادَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ مِنْ وَسَطِكُمْ،
verses.kjv: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
verses.web: Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for Yahweh your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا أَنْتُمُ ٱلْمُلْتَصِقُونَ بِٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكُمْ فَجَمِيعُكُمْ أَحْيَاءٌ ٱلْيَوْمَ.
verses.kjv: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God [are] alive every one of you this day.
verses.web: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.

verses.ar: اُنْظُرْ. قَدْ عَلَّمْتُكُمْ فَرَائِضَ وَأَحْكَامًا كَمَا أَمَرَنِي ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهِي، لِكَيْ تَعْمَلُوا هَكَذَا فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي أَنْتُمْ دَاخِلُونَ إِلَيْهَا لِكَيْ تَمْتَلِكُوهَا.
verses.kjv: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
verses.web: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.

verses.ar: فَٱحْفَظُوا وَٱعْمَلُوا. لِأَنَّ ذَلِكَ حِكْمَتُكُمْ وَفِطْنَتُكُمْ أَمَامَ أَعْيُنِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ كُلَّ هَذِهِ ٱلْفَرَائِضِ، فَيَقُولُونَ: هَذَا ٱلشَّعْبُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ شَعْبٌ حَكِيمٌ وَفَطِنٌ.
verses.kjv: Keep therefore and do [them;] for this [is] your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation [is] a wise and understanding people.
verses.web: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ أَيُّ شَعْبٍ هُوَ عَظِيمٌ لَهُ آلِهَةٌ قَرِيبَةٌ مِنْهُ كَٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِنَا فِي كُلِّ أَدْعِيَتِنَا إِلَيْهِ؟
verses.kjv: For what nation [is there so] great, who [hath] God [so] nigh unto them, as the LORD our God [is] in all [things that] we call upon him [for]?
verses.web: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as Yahweh our God is whenever we call on him?

verses.ar: وَأَيُّ شَعْبٍ هُوَ عَظِيمٌ لَهُ فَرَائِضُ وَأَحْكَامٌ عَادِلَةٌ مِثْلُ كُلِّ هَذِهِ ٱلشَّرِيعَةِ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا وَاضِعٌ أَمَامَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ؟
verses.kjv: And what nation [is there so] great, that hath statutes and judgments [so] righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.web: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

verses.ar: «إِنَّمَا ٱحْتَرِزْ وَٱحفَظْ نَفْسَكَ جِدًّا لِئَلَّا تَنْسَى ٱلْأُمُورَ ٱلَّتِي أَبْصَرَتْ عَيْنَاكَ، وَلِئَلَّا تَزُولَ مِنْ قَلْبِكَ كُلَّ أَيَّامِ حَيَاتِكَ. وَعَلِّمْهَا أَوْلَادَكَ وَأَوْلَادَ أَوْلَادِكَ.
verses.kjv: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons;
verses.web: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—

verses.ar: فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلَّذِي وَقَفْتَ فِيهِ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ فِي حُورِيبَ حِينَ قَالَ لِي ٱلرَّبُّ: ٱجْمَعْ لِي ٱلشَّعْبَ فَأُسْمِعَهُمْ كَلَامِي، لِكَيْ يَتَعَلَّمُوا أَنْ يَخَافُونِي كُلَّ ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلَّتِي هُمْ فِيهَا أَحْيَاءٌ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَيُعَلِّمُوا أَوْلَادَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: [Specially] the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and [that] they may teach their children.
verses.web: the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”

verses.ar: فَتَقَدَّمْتُمْ وَوَقَفْتُمْ فِي أَسْفَلِ ٱلْجَبَلِ، وَٱلْجَبَلُ يَضْطَرِمُ بِٱلنَّارِ إِلَى كَبِدِ ٱلسَّمَاءِ، بِظَلَامٍ وَسَحَابٍ وَضَبَابٍ.
verses.kjv: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
verses.web: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

verses.ar: فَكَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنْ وَسَطِ ٱلنَّارِ وَأَنْتُمْ سَامِعُونَ صَوْتَ كَلَامٍ، وَلَكِنْ لَمْ تَرَوْا صُورَةً بَلْ صَوْتًا.
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only [ye heard] a voice.
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.

verses.ar: وَأَخْبَرَكُمْ بِعَهْدِهِ ٱلَّذِي أَمَرَكُمْ أَنْ تَعْمَلُوا بِهِ، ٱلْكَلِمَاتِ ٱلْعَشَرِ، وَكَتَبَهُ عَلَى لَوْحَيْ حَجَرٍ.
verses.kjv: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, [even] ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.web: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.

verses.ar: وَإِيَّايَ أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْوَقْتِ أَنْ أُعَلِّمَكُمْ فَرَائِضَ وَأَحْكَامًا لِكَيْ تَعْمَلُوهَا فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي أَنْتُمْ عَابِرُونَ إِلَيْهَا لِتَمْتَلِكُوهَا.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
verses.web: Yahweh commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

verses.ar: «فَٱحْتَفِظُوا جِدًّا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ. فَإِنَّكُمْ لَمْ تَرَوْا صُورَةً مَّا يَوْمَ كَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ فِي حُورِيبَ مِنْ وَسَطِ ٱلنَّارِ.
verses.kjv: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day [that] the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
verses.web: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,

verses.ar: لِئَلَّا تَفْسُدُوا وَتَعْمَلُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ تِمْثَالًا مَنْحُوتًا، صُورَةَ مِثَالٍ مَّا، شِبْهَ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى،
verses.kjv: Lest ye corrupt [yourselves], and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.web: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

verses.ar: شِبْهَ بَهِيمَةٍ مَّا مِمَّا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ، شِبْهَ طَيْرٍ مَّا ذِي جَنَاحٍ مِمَّا يَطِيرُ فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ،
verses.kjv: The likeness of any beast that [is] on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
verses.web: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,

verses.ar: شِبْهَ دَبِيبٍ مَّا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ، شِبْهَ سَمَكٍ مَّا مِمَّا فِي ٱلْمَاءِ مِنْ تَحْتِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that [is] in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.web: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

verses.ar: وَلِئَلَّا تَرْفَعَ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَاءِ، وَتَنْظُرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ، كُلَّ جُنْدِ ٱلسَّمَاءِ ٱلَّتِي قَسَمَهَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ لِجَمِيعِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ ٱلَّتِي تَحْتَ كُلِّ ٱلسَّمَاءِ، فَتَغْتَرَّ وَتَسْجُدَ لَهَا وَتَعْبُدَهَا.
verses.kjv: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, [even] all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
verses.web: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Yahweh your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.

verses.ar: وَأَنْتُمْ قَدْ أَخَذَكُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ وَأَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنْ كُورِ ٱلْحَدِيدِ مِنْ مِصْرَ، لِكَيْ تَكُونُوا لَهُ شَعْبَ مِيرَاثٍ كَمَا فِي هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ.
verses.kjv: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, [even] out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as [ye are] this day.
verses.web: But Yahweh has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.

verses.ar: وَغَضِبَ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَيَّ بِسَبَبِكُمْ، وَأَقْسَمَ إِنِّي لَا أَعْبُرُ ٱلْأُرْدُنَّ وَلَا أَدْخُلُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْجَيِّدَةَ ٱلَّتِي ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ يُعْطِيكَ نَصِيبًا.
verses.kjv: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee [for] an inheritance:
verses.web: Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance;

verses.ar: فَأَمُوتُ أَنَا فِي هَذِهِ ٱلْأَرْضِ، لَا أَعْبُرُ ٱلْأُرْدُنَّ، وَأَمَّا أَنْتُمْ فَتَعْبُرُونَ وَتَمْتَلِكُونَ تِلْكَ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْجَيِّدَةَ.
verses.kjv: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.web: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.

verses.ar: اِحْتَرِزُوا مِنْ أَنْ تَنْسَوْا عَهْدَ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكُمُ ٱلَّذِي قَطَعَهُ مَعَكُمْ، وَتَصْنَعُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ تِمْثَالًا مَنْحُوتًا، صُورَةَ كُلِّ مَا نَهَاكَ عَنْهُ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ.
verses.kjv: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, [or] the likeness of any [thing], which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
verses.web: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which Yahweh your God has forbidden you.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكَ هُوَ نَارٌ آكِلَةٌ، إِلَهٌ غَيُورٌ.
verses.kjv: For the LORD thy God [is] a consuming fire, [even] a jealous God.
verses.web: For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

verses.ar: «إِذَا وَلَدْتُمْ أَوْلَادًا وَأَوْلَادَ أَوْلَادٍ، وَأَطَلْتُمُ ٱلزَّمَانَ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَفَسَدْتُمْ وَصَنَعْتُمْ تِمْثَالًا مَنْحُوتًا صُورَةَ شَيْءٍ مَّا، وَفَعَلْتُمُ ٱلشَّرَّ فِي عَيْنَيِ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكُمْ لِإِغَاظَتِهِ،
verses.kjv: ¶ When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt [yourselves], and make a graven image, [or] the likeness of any [thing], and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
verses.web: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,

verses.ar: أُشْهِدُ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلسَّمَاءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ أَنَّكُمْ تَبِيدُونَ سَرِيعًا عَنِ ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي أَنْتُمْ عَابِرُونَ ٱلْأُرْدُنَّ إِلَيْهَا لِتَمْتَلِكُوهَا. لَا تُطِيلُونَ ٱلْأَيَّامَ عَلَيْهَا، بَلْ تَهْلِكُونَ لَا مَحَالَةَ.
verses.kjv: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong [your] days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.web: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.

verses.ar: وَيُبَدِّدُكُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ فِي ٱلشُّعُوبِ، فَتَبْقَوْنَ عَدَدًا قَلِيلًا بَيْنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ ٱلَّتِي يَسُوقُكُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَيْهَا.
verses.kjv: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
verses.web: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where Yahweh will lead you away.

verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُونَ هُنَاكَ آلِهَةً صَنْعَةَ أَيْدِي ٱلنَّاسِ مِنْ خَشَبٍ وَحَجَرٍ مِمَّا لَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يَأْكُلُ وَلَا يَشُمُّ.
verses.kjv: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.web: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنْ طَلَبْتَ مِنْ هُنَاكَ ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكَ تَجِدْهُ إِذَا ٱلْتَمَسْتَهُ بِكُلِّ قَلْبِكَ وَبِكُلِّ نَفْسِكَ.
verses.kjv: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find [him], if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.web: But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.ar: عِنْدَمَا ضُيِّقَ عَلَيْكَ وَأَصَابَتْكَ كُلُّ هَذِهِ ٱلْأُمُورِ فِي آخِرِ ٱلْأَيَّامِ، تَرْجِعُ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ وَتَسْمَعُ لِقَوْلِهِ،
verses.kjv: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, [even] in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
verses.web: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to Yahweh your God and listen to his voice.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكَ إِلَهٌ رَحِيمٌ، لَا يَتْرُكُكَ وَلَا يُهْلِكُكَ وَلَا يَنْسَى عَهْدَ آبَائِكَ ٱلَّذِي أَقْسَمَ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: (For the LORD thy God [is] a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verses.web: For Yahweh your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.

verses.ar: «فَٱسْأَلْ عَنِ ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْأُولَى ٱلَّتِي كَانَتْ قَبْلَكَ، مِنَ ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱللهُ فِيهِ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ أَقْصَاءِ ٱلسَّمَاءِ إِلَى أَقْصَائِهَا. هَلْ جَرَى مِثْلُ هَذَا ٱلْأَمْرِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ، أَوْ هَلْ سُمِعَ نَظِيرُهُ؟
verses.kjv: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and [ask] from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been [any such thing] as this great thing [is], or hath been heard like it?
verses.web: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?

verses.ar: هَلْ سَمِعَ شَعْبٌ صَوْتَ ٱللهِ يَتَكَلَّمُ مِنْ وَسَطِ ٱلنَّارِ كَمَا سَمِعْتَ أَنْتَ، وَعَاشَ؟
verses.kjv: Did [ever] people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.web: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

verses.ar: أَوْ هَلْ شَرَعَ ٱللهُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ وَيَأْخُذَ لِنَفْسِهِ شَعْبًا مِنْ وَسَطِ شَعْبٍ، بِتَجَارِبَ وَآيَاتٍ وَعَجَائِبَ وَحَرْبٍ وَيَدٍ شَدِيدَةٍ وَذِرَاعٍ رَفِيعَةٍ وَمَخَاوِفَ عَظِيمَةٍ، مِثْلَ كُلِّ مَا فَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ فِي مِصْرَ أَمَامَ أَعْيُنِكُمْ؟
verses.kjv: Or hath God assayed to go [and] take him a nation from the midst of [another] nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.web: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ قَدْ أُرِيتَ لِتَعْلَمَ أَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ هُوَ ٱلْإِلَهُ. لَيْسَ آخَرَ سِوَاهُ.
verses.kjv: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he [is] God; [there is] none else beside him.
verses.web: It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.

verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ أَسْمَعَكَ صَوْتَهُ لِيُنْذِرَكَ، وَعَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَرَاكَ نَارَهُ ٱلْعَظِيمَةَ، وَسَمِعْتَ كَلَامَهُ مِنْ وَسَطِ ٱلنَّارِ.
verses.kjv: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.web: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.

verses.ar: وَلِأَجْلِ أَنَّهُ أَحَبَّ آبَاءَكَ وَٱخْتَارَ نَسْلَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ، أَخْرَجَكَ بِحَضْرَتِهِ بِقُوَّتِهِ ٱلْعَظِيمَةِ مِنْ مِصْرَ،
verses.kjv: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
verses.web: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;

verses.ar: لِكَيْ يَطْرُدَ مِنْ أَمَامِكَ شُعُوبًا أَكْبَرَ وَأَعْظَمَ مِنْكَ، وَيَأْتِيَ بِكَ وَيُعْطِيَكَ أَرْضَهُمْ نَصِيبًا كَمَا فِي هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ.
verses.kjv: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou [art], to bring thee in, to give thee their land [for] an inheritance, as [it is] this day.
verses.web: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.

verses.ar: فَٱعْلَمِ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَرَدِّدْ فِي قَلْبِكَ أَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ هُوَ ٱلْإِلَهُ فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ مِنْ فَوْقُ، وَعَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنْ أَسْفَلُ. لَيْسَ سِوَاهُ.
verses.kjv: Know therefore this day, and consider [it] in thine heart, that the LORD he [is] God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: [there is] none else.
verses.web: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that Yahweh himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.

verses.ar: وَٱحْفَظْ فَرَائِضَهُ وَوَصَايَاهُ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أُوصِيكَ بِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ لِكَيْ يُحْسَنَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى أَوْلَادِكَ مِنْ بَعْدِكَ، وَلِكَيْ تُطِيلَ أَيَّامَكَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ يُعْطِيكَ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ».
verses.kjv: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong [thy] days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
verses.web: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for all time.

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ أَفْرَزَ مُوسَى ثَلَاثَ مُدُنٍ فِي عَبْرِ ٱلْأُرْدُنِّ نَحْوَ شُرُوقِ ٱلشَّمْسِ
verses.kjv: ¶ Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.web: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,

verses.ar: لِكَيْ يَهْرُبَ إِلَيْهَا ٱلْقَاتِلُ ٱلَّذِي يَقْتُلُ صَاحِبَهُ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ، وَهُوَ غَيْرُ مُبْغِضٍ لَهُ مُنْذُ أَمْسِ وَمَا قَبْلَهُ. يَهْرُبُ إِلَى إِحْدَى تِلْكَ ٱلْمُدُنِ فَيَحْيَا.
verses.kjv: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.web: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:

verses.ar: بَاصِرَ فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ فِي أَرْضِ ٱلسَّهْلِ لِلرَّأُوبَيْنِيِّينَ، وَرَامُوتَ فِي جِلْعَادَ لِلْجَادِيِّينَ، وَجُولَانَ فِي بَاشَانَ لِلْمَنَسِّيِّينَ.
verses.kjv: [Namely], Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
verses.web: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ هِيَ ٱلشَّرِيعَةُ ٱلَّتِي وَضَعَهَا مُوسَى أَمَامَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And this [is] the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
verses.web: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.

verses.ar: هَذِهِ هِيَ ٱلشَّهَادَاتُ وَٱلْفَرَائِضُ وَٱلْأَحْكَامُ ٱلَّتِي كَلَّمَ بِهَا مُوسَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عِنْدَ خُرُوجِهِمْ مِنْ مِصْرَ
verses.kjv: These [are] the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
verses.web: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,

verses.ar: فِي عَبْرِ ٱلْأُرْدُنِّ فِي ٱلْجِوَاءِ مُقَابِلَ بَيْتِ فَغُورَ، فِي أَرْضِ سِيحُونَ مَلِكِ ٱلْأَمُورِيِّينَ ٱلَّذِي كَانَ سَاكِنًا فِي حَشْبُونَ، ٱلَّذِي ضَرَبَهُ مُوسَى وَبَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ عِنْدَ خُرُوجِهِمْ مِنْ مِصْرَ
verses.kjv: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
verses.web: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.

verses.ar: وَٱمْتَلَكُوا أَرْضَهُ وَأَرْضَ عُوجٍ مَلِكِ بَاشَانَ، مَلِكَيِ ٱلْأَمُورِيِّينَ، ٱللَّذَيْنِ فِي عَبْرِ ٱلْأُرْدُنِّ نَحْوَ شُرُوقِ ٱلشَّمْسِ.
verses.kjv: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which [were] on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.web: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;

verses.ar: مِنْ عَرُوعِيرَ ٱلَّتِي عَلَى حَافَةِ وَادِي أَرْنُونَ إِلَى جَبَلِ سِيئُونَ ٱلَّذِي هُوَ حَرْمُونُ
verses.kjv: From Aroer, which [is] by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which [is] Hermon,
verses.web: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Siyon (also called Hermon),

verses.ar: وَكُلَّ ٱلْعَرَبَةِ فِي عَبْرِ ٱلْأُرْدُنِّ نَحْوَ ٱلشُّرُوقِ إِلَى بَحْرِ ٱلْعَرَبَةِ تَحْتَ سُفُوحِ ٱلْفِسْجَةِ.
verses.kjv: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
verses.web: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
